summary: Implemented scorer-running and maestro_score_workflow with fixed Jev classifier questions, complete workflow/Git evidence collection, separate normalized scores, raw-response persistence, failure handling, cancellation protection, and runtime completion guidance. npm run check passed all 323 tests across 45 files; git diff --check passed.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: Ran npm run check. Updated existing run-builder, run-verifier, resolve-findings, run-simplifier, and record-simplifier-handoff integration tests confirm all five completion rows now save scorer-running: simplifier completion, builder with both later roles disabled, verifier without findings with simplifier disabled, rejection of all findings with simplifier disabled, and Git-unavailable simplifier skipping. Inspected centralized destinations in src/workflow/transitions.ts.

Ran npm run check including the existing builder-disabled mark-spec-ready integration test and frozen-draft transition test. Inspected getSpecReadyDestination in src/workflow/transitions.ts: builder-disabled approval goes directly to candidate-ready. Approval does not invoke the scoring tool or create scores; agents/maestro.md instructs spec-only summaries not to read stale evaluations.

Ran npm run check including the real temporary Git repository evidence test in src/tools/main/score-workflow.integration.test.ts. Verified proposal.md, spec.md, design.md, B1/B2/V1/V2/S handoff identities and recorded decisions, staged src/export.ts, unstaged src/escape.ts, untracked src/csv helpers.ts and a quote/dollar/semicolon filename. Tracked evaluation.json and untracked evaluation.raw.json are excluded. Inspected scoreWorkflow.ts passing the collected evidence directly as classifier state before persistence.

Inspected collectHandoffs in src/score/collectScoreEvidence.ts: recursively enumerates present files and sorts identities numerically, without reading role configuration or requiring expected reports. B1 alone is collected alone; missing handoffs directory returns an empty array. Successful scoring tests in npm run check also run with no handoffs.

Inspected src/score/scoreWorkflow.ts: context.modelRegistry.getModelOfType('classifier', 'openrouter', 'typesafe/jev-1.14') followed by registry.classify with Pi-managed credentials and maxRetries: 0. Inspected getScoreQuestions.ts and questions.md: exact correctness and verificationQuality IDs, score question type, and all five exact ordered levels for each rubric. Tool schema accepts only specId. No mocked-request assertions or Jev judgment tests were added.

Ran npm run check including the verifier-running rejection test: no classifier request and no evaluation report. Inspected the same phase guard in scoreWorkflow.ts for candidate-ready: rejects before evidence collection, inference, and writes. Active spec identity is also checked before scoring.

Ran npm run check. The fractional-level persistence case supplies correctness 3.6/confidence 0.8 and verificationQuality 2/confidence 0.6, and checks saved scores 90 and 50 with confidences unchanged. Exact saved-report equality excludes aggregate fields. Inspected normalizeScoreResult.ts for independent multiplication by 25 without rounding or clamping.

Ran npm run check. Whole-level persistence case supplies correctness 4/0.9 and verificationQuality 3/0.7 with provider, model, usage, timestamp, and stopReason. Actual raw file equals the complete supplied result; report identifies spec/model/rubric version and success with 100/0.9 and 75/0.7. Both cases overwrite pre-existing files and save candidate-ready only after successful persistence.

Ran npm run check. Scoring tests cover every table condition: absent exact classifier, returned Unauthorized error, invalid correctness score 5, real Git repository with HEAD removed, and truncated Git diff output. Failure reports contain reasons and no scores; returned responses are preserved, absent responses are not fabricated, and stale raw output is removed. Inspected finite score/confidence/type/stopReason checks and collection error handling for other required failures.

Ran npm run check. Success, failure, overwrite, owner-cancelled classifier response, and unwritable-report tests verify resulting phases. Inspected scoreWorkflow.ts: fresh collection/request on each invocation; both required files saved or stale raw removed before SCORER_DONE; cancellation throws without completion; persistence errors leave scorer-running. Inspected transitions.ts and extension finalization: omitting the scoring call provides no scoring completion event and cannot arm candidate-ready finalization.

Inspected agents/maestro.md completion instructions and score-workflow.ts tool output: separate scores/confidences and both report paths on success; failure reason/path and no score on failure; no overall score or correctness-proof claim. Reviewed actual fractional saved-output values (90/0.8 and 50/0.6) from the passing persistence test against these instructions, and reviewed the controlled streamed final failure summary in extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts, including no-score wording and saved report path. Missing-exact-classifier reason is verified through its saved failure test. No instruction-string tests or live Jev judgment calls were added.

notes: Verification stayed within Maestro-owned behavior using real Pi session registration and temporary Git repositories, with supplied classifier responses at the external boundary. No live Jev/provider inference or dependency changes were needed.
Human-facing documentation updates remain excluded as approved. Runtime agent instructions were updated. No existing roadmap item covers this scoring feature, so ROADMAP.md was left unchanged.
Temporary verification projects were cleaned by test cleanup hooks, and temporary command logs were removed. Frozen contract documents and workflow state were not edited directly.
